## CoA Server Manager 0.6.22 / Server 0.261018.70

### Manager
- Updated Custom Races client patches to 1.8, including Drakkin, Drakonid and updated racial abilities
- Added updated race appearances and cursor addons
- Existing client files are preserved when installing or removing race patches

### Server
- Integrated the latest reviewed CoA upstream changes
- Updated SQUID Playerbots to 2.5
- Added XP Hotspots and one-button rotation assistance
- Added Novice Riding and the starter mount reward at riding trainers
- Improved quest objectives, map markers and Pale Reach quest content
- Fixed Worldforged upgrade order and Bloodforged drop restrictions
- Fixed dungeon boss mechanics, difficulty rewards and loot handling

### Custom races
- Added Drakkin and Drakonid with their racial abilities
- Updated racial abilities and appearances, including Mechagnomes
- Fixed starting locations and missing weapon skills for custom races

### Classes
- Fixed Necromancer minion attacks, range, models and Sacrifice Undead cooldown handling
- Fixed Chronomancer Incarnation of Chaos, Echo Fragments and Infinite Clone behavior
- Fixed Tinker Rocket Boots movement, Gear Grind procs and Tracer marks
- Fixed Ranger stealth action bars and several ability interactions
- Included additional class ability and tooltip fixes from upstream

### Manastorm
- Restored Manastorm Endless integration and required database updates for existing servers
- Included matching client UI fixes as optional files
- Added startup checks to catch an enabled Manastorm backend failing to initialize

Prepared candidate; stable channel is unchanged. Requires Manager 0.6.22.

Validation: signed package and clean installation verified; direct upgrades from 0.2.0, 0.261015.58 and 0.261013.54 passed. Gameplay and the remaining extended qualification scenarios were not run; see qualification.json for exact coverage.

## CoA Server Manager 0.6.17 / Server 0.261015.58

### Manager

- New servers now install the current stable build directly, without installing 2.0 first
- Fixed completed repairs leaving the server stuck in a maintenance state
- Servers can now stop even when startup templates or MySQL process records are damaged
- Repair now preserves database accounts, views, procedures and triggers, with improved rollback after failures
- Interrupted SQUID database imports are now reported by Check and Repair
- Update errors remain visible on Overview, with technical details and a copy button
- Improved update preparation progress and diagnostics for shutdown failures and port conflicts
- Updated Custom Races client patches to 1.7 while preserving existing race assets

### Server

- Integrated 34 CoA upstream commits
- Updated Custom Races to 1.7, adding playable Grummle and their racial abilities
- Updated SQUID Playerbots to 2.3.1
- Added complete installation packages for the current server release
- Improved shutdown recovery and startup configuration errors

### Content scaling

- Creature health settings are now respected while Content Scaling is enabled

**Server**
- Added: Players can hide armor and use previously blocked names with custom races. Use .hidearmor to toggle armor visibility for everyone without unequipping items. The choice persists across logins. Enabling custom races removes the stock profanity and reserved-name filters.

- Fixed: Refresh terrain and navigation data for CoA zones. Rebuild maps, collision data and movement meshes from the CoA client, including the Cain Family Estate area. Offline integrity and navigation checks passed; gameplay verification is still pending.

**Companion bots**
- Fixed: Random bot spawning and auto-fill no longer leak accounts or freeze the server. BG and LFG auto-fill now reuses existing offline bots instead of creating duplicate characters. Account lookup is indexed to prevent hitches, bot accounts are cleaned up on purge, and `CoaBots.Enable = 0` completely disables all bot background activity.

**Content Scaling**
- Fixed: Fix LFG bot fill and party queues, battleground access, and Manastorm entry. Allow battlegrounds and Manastorm instances to bypass dungeon scaling locks, resolve party queues properly in LFG, and enable bot fill without startup race conditions.
- Fixed: Private dungeon access no longer bypasses restrictions on unrelated maps. The private dungeon exemption applies only to the assigned map and an active private instance.

----- next message -----

**Server** (for server owners)
- Added: Generate navigation data from the CoA client with pinned tools. A separate generation script extracts maps and vmaps and builds mmaps in a new directory. It records input, tool and output hashes and rejects client archives that change during generation. Generated data still requires gameplay qualification before publication.
- Changed: Server updates require a Manager with safe background startup. Update the Manager before installing new server packages so the local console cannot stop a background world server.
- Fixed: Older repacks receive the missing creature display default during updates. A targeted database migration aligns the legacy display preset column with the release schema without changing existing NPC appearance data.
- Fixed: Raid boss initialization matches the current difficulty schedule schema. Module initialization uses explicit column lists and per-difficulty effects, including Shazzrah's area Nova. Both fresh tables and the previous schedule layout are supported.
- Fixed: Server integration includes current upstream fixes and recognizes shipped race data. The integration includes current CoA gameplay fixes. Repository checks recognize the exact shipped race DBC assets by hash while still rejecting modified or personal binary data.

----- next message -----

**Companion bots** (for server owners)
- Added: Custom races bot support and dedicated lore naming. Companion bots now respect the Custom Races bot switch and exclusion lists. When enabled, bots spawn with lore names: unique races (Ogres, Sethrak, Naga, Vulpera, Pandaren, etc.) use dedicated name pools, while related sub-races reuse their canon racial naming conventions.
- Changed: The experimental SQUID race preset follows the current race release. Custom-race bots now use the upstream supported-race preset, excluding Test Race, Skyborne and Darkfallen. The standard-races preset continues to exclude all custom races.
- Fixed: Bot account cleanup preserves accounts used by other realms. Cleanup uses the server account lifecycle and removes associated access, ban and mute records while retaining accounts with characters on another realm.
- Fixed: Companion race selection respects module switches and excluded races. Companions cannot use custom races while race support is disabled. Both exclusion lists apply; spawning stops safely if no races remain available.
- Fixed: Disabling custom races for SQUID bots now excludes all nonstandard races. The standard-races preset keeps only the ten original playable races. High elves, worgen and other custom race IDs are excluded, and the displayed setting reads complete race IDs rather than matching number substrings.

----- next message -----

**Content Scaling** (for server owners)
- Added: Allow removing class requirements from equipment and tier sets. Administrators can enable CoAContentScaling.Items.RemoveClassRestrictions to clear class requirements on equipment, allowing all characters to equip tier sets and class-locked items.
- Added: Configure parallel and global level scaling progression modes. Server owners can select between sequential compression, parallel scaling (Classic 1-60 with TBC and WotLK 45-60), or global 1-60 scaling across all expansions using Progression.Mode.
- Fixed: Content Scaling preserves your creature health settings. World, dungeon, raid and per-map health multipliers now remain effective with Content Scaling enabled, including when creatures change level or encounter group size.

**Server modules** (for server owners)
- Changed: Custom race integration includes the upstream talent reset update. The server integration follows the current custom race release, including its talent reset command and client message handler.

**Game client** (for server owners)
- Changed: Custom race client installation follows the current upstream release. The installer verifies the current race archives and includes the two additional MPQs. Legacy patch hashes remain available so upgrading never mistakes the old custom executable for an original launcher file.

## Navigation data refresh

- Rebuilt maps, vmaps and mmaps from the CoA client with the pinned extractor revision.
- Refreshed terrain and navigation data around Cain Estate.
- Verified all 49,421 files, loaded all 8,189 navmesh tiles and checked 50 local paths offline without errors.
- This cumulative Windows update preserves the server binaries, SQL migrations and configuration policies from 0.261011.800006.
- Requires CoA Server Manager 0.6.15, which avoids repeated recovery-journal writes during large updates.
- Includes signed release-lock.json, qualification.json and compatibility-matrix.json. Manager upgrade checks cover the base and two stable releases.

Gameplay and Linux qualification have not been run for this navigation refresh. Stable promotion is explicitly authorized by the maintainer for this data-only update; the qualification report records that scope.

The navigation archive is byte-identical to the payload qualified as 0.261012.800007. This immutable successor corrects its minimum Manager metadata; qualification.json explicitly records inherited test evidence and the exact source manifest hash.

Windows stable release.

- Includes 130 upstream commits since the core revision of the previous stable package.
- SQUID Playerbots v2.0.
- Custom races coa-custom-1.5.1, including persistent .hidearmor and relaxed name restrictions when enabled.
- Updated raid boss schedule initialization for the current difficulty schema.
- Preserves released SQL migrations; new Retreat and Northshire fixes are applied through separate migrations.
- CoA Companions remains on the previous revision.
- Portable Characters and Portable Session Bridge are excluded.

Validation: Windows binaries and unit verification, SQL/schema contract, isolated auth/world startup, signed archive verification, and Manager upgrades from 0.2.0, 0.261010.32 and 0.261006.1 passed.

This release uses an explicitly authorized one-time Windows-only promotion. Linux and the remaining in-game scenarios have not been qualified. Newly generated maps/vmaps/mmaps are not included.

Use Manager v0.6.13 to receive this release through the signed stable channel. Older Manager versions retain the legacy stable package.

Superseded by server-0.261012.800008: the minimum Manager metadata needs correction. The navigation payload passed all three Manager upgrade scenarios, but this release must not be installed with Managers older than 0.6.15.
Generated maps/vmaps/mmaps. Integrity and Detour checks passed; gameplay qualification remains pending. Source assets for the navigation-only stable update requested by the maintainer.

# CoA Server Manager 0.6.5 / Server 0.261006.1

Update CoA Server Manager to 0.6.5 first, then update the server. This server package requires Manager 0.6.5.

## Server updates and recovery

- Recognize known, signed historical migration checksums without rewriting migration history or replaying applied SQL.
- Check migration history and SQL files before replacing server files. Interrupted or failed migrations still require recovery.
- Preserve damaged update records and protect recovery points belonging to unfinished updates. Check saved copies before restoring them.
- Refresh saved update status after update and recovery attempts, including failures.
- Recognize launcher adjustments made by the Manager, including older Wildcard launchers. Custom edits still require a choice.
- Stop offering an already installed launcher update after checking again.
- Reject older server packages. Use the update's recovery point to undo an update.
- Restore missing Wildcard card and specialization-cache tables through a new corrective migration, preserving existing tables and data.
- Fix launcher integration imports when using the server's isolated Python runtime.

## SQUID Playerbots

- Include SQUID Playerbots v1.8.1 together with the matching core, launcher and Manager integration.
- Provide translated bot settings, release information and controls for the active bot system. Prevent conflicting bot systems from starting together.
- Include the SQUID database in recovery points when installed.
- Keep servers with SQUID disabled independent of its database startup hooks.
- Detect unfinished initial database imports instead of treating partially imported tables as complete.
- Allow more time for large SQL imports and initial bot creation. The Manager startup deadline is up to 45 minutes when SQUID is enabled; ordinary startup deadlines are unchanged.
- Preserve historical SQL files and migration history. Only new migrations are applied.
- Require an explicit keep-or-replace decision when updating imported server binaries protected by their original launcher or updater.

## Local candidate validation

The signed final package passed an update and startup of both CoA and Wildcard on a marked disposable installation. Selected account, character and inventory fields were preserved, historical migrations were skipped, and a repeated update check was clean. Fresh SQUID database import and repeated startup were checked using the same native binaries and SQL as the final package.

Version 0.261005.22. Requires Manager 0.6.4 or newer.

Fixes startup with the isolated Python runtime. Includes grouped bot looting defaults, partial Dungeon Finder parties, optional open-world life steal, dungeon damage controls, auction source filtering, and cumulative database repairs.

Built from the successful Windows binaries job in run 37240647069; packaged locally using the corrected release tooling. Signed archive contents and complete database contract verified. All 1746 cumulative migrations and full native startup passed on a disposable database.

## Server 0.261005.0 — database update fix

Update CoA Server Manager to 0.6.2 first. This package requires Manager 0.6.2.

- Creates five missing Wildcard character tables using a new corrective migration, even when their historical migrations are already marked applied.
- Preserves existing table rows and avoids replaying historical destructive SQL.
- Includes the full expected database schema so Manager can detect missing tables and columns.

Binary and existing payload provenance: every one of the 1,848 files is byte-identical to the previously signed edge package 0.261004.20. Only the new corrective SQL and generated schema contract are added. The exact archived SQL was applied on an isolated signed-base database; the resulting package was signed and all archive entries verified. No user database was modified during release validation.
